title: English Practice Quiz 0004
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A polite way to disagree is:
options: I see your point, but I have a different view.
questions.explanation: This phrase acknowledges the other person before presenting a different view.

questions.question: If it rains, we ___ indoors.
questions.explanation: The first conditional uses if + present simple, will + base verb.

questions.question: I have ___ friends in this city.
questions.explanation: A few is used with countable plural nouns.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: After doesn't, use the base form of the verb: like.

questions.question: Choose the opposite of 'polite'.
questions.explanation: Rude is the opposite of polite.

questions.question: She is interested ___ music.
questions.explanation: The adjective interested is followed by in.

questions.question: Which word has a different beginning sound?
questions.explanation: This begins with the voiced /ð/ sound; the others begin with the unvoiced /θ/ sound.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use does + subject + base verb with he, she or it.

questions.question: If I were you, I ___ apologise.
questions.explanation: If I were you is followed by would for advice.

questions.question: She is the ___ student in the class.
questions.explanation: Use the superlative tallest when comparing one with the whole class.
